scientific_question: Can an unbiased stochastic retraction through the existing fast Cartesian Pair-VQ codes repair compact-gradient path drift without adding a dense master weight, ambient residual, per-weight optimizer state, or inference FLOPs?

dense_path_replay_result.finding: The production compact family tracks the exact dense trajectory inside the +0.05 CE gate and recovers 99.9347 percent of terminal weight energy, but its deterministic local projector recovers only 0.0118 percent of the final requested-step energy. Endpoint capacity and live tracking pass; the small-step tangent fails.

theory.measured_defect: Deterministic nearest-cell projection is piecewise constant in each fast-code coordinate. Its Jacobian is zero away from cell boundaries, so late Muon steps can change the desired ambient weight while leaving the decoded compact state unchanged.
theory.registered_retraction: For adjacent ordered levels a_i <= x <= a_(i+1), emit a_(i+1) with probability p=(x-a_i)/(a_(i+1)-a_i), otherwise emit a_i. Apply this independently to both coordinates of each existing uint8 fast pair code after the same learned-level update.
theory.unbiasedness: E[q(x) | x] = p*a_(i+1) + (1-p)*a_i = x for requests inside the learned level range. Clipped out-of-range requests retain the existing boundary behavior.
theory.path_hypothesis: The stochastic decoded step is noisy per update but has the requested local tangent in expectation. Error feedback and the existing fast residual integrate this zero-mean noise over time, which directly targets the observed gradient-path drift without changing representational capacity.
theory.resume_identity: Every module derives its draw seed from the registered Pair-VQ module seed and optimizer step. Same seed, state, and step reproduce exactly; no persistent RNG tensor is stored.
theory.falsifier: If the endpoint remains more than +0.05 CE behind the matched parent despite expected retraction bias recovery >=0.999, unbiased local transport alone is insufficient; the next theory must address stochastic variance or functional-gradient estimation, not add codebook bits or scale the model.

required_invariants: same registered seed, optimizer step, levels, and requested vectors produce identical codes
empirical sampling mean converges to the requested sub-cell coordinate
stochastic mode is rejected unless the existing fast residual is active
byte accounting is identical to the deterministic compact endpoint
legacy deterministic Pair-VQ behavior is unchanged when the flag is false

storage_and_compute.training_overhead: Two uniform random draws and interval interpolation per fast-code vector at each existing code refresh; no additional dense decode, optimizer tensor, or forward operator.

decision_rule.pass: If terminal fixed-window CE <=5.4110 and the expected-bias and storage gates pass, stochastic fast retraction closes the smallest-rung compact full-MLP endpoint and may be validated at 5 TPP before any larger width.
decision_rule.loss_fail_bias_pass: Reject unbiasedness alone as sufficient. Quantify accumulated sampling variance and test one theory-selected variance-controlled compact estimator; do not sweep learning rates, bits, or model widths.
decision_rule.bias_fail: Invalidate the implementation and repair the stochastic interval/clipping logic before interpreting CE.
decision_rule.mfu_fail: Optimize the exact stochastic retraction implementation and repeat only the foreground MFU gate; scientific training remains forbidden.

operations.preflight: Foreground-poll one standard exact-config real-training MFU gate with one warmup and eight timed updates; no watchdog or callback.
operations.scientific_run: Expected above five minutes and below two hours. Launch only after the gate passes, with one idempotent terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog and no progress or healthy-heartbeat callbacks.
operations.terminal_action: Verify terminal artifacts and fixed-checkpoint comparison, seal hashes and gate outcomes in the active project note, then continue only with the causally authorized compact full-MLP successor.
operations.storage: save_checkpoint=false; retain only config, plan, MFU certificate/log, training log/status/provenance, compact terminal result, and hashes.
